I have been farming in Dowa for many years, and for my beans plot I do not buy chemical fertilizer because the crop fixes its own nitrogen and fertilizer is too expensive for our household. I will spread manure from our livestock to keep the soil fertile, and I will plant seed I saved from last season because it is reliable and costs nothing. This plot is small enough that my family can manage all the work between us, and we depend entirely on the rains since we have no way to irrigate.
